728-1116-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Gain life.

Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.

Garrison Excavator triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

856-5226-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.

Repeat from step 3.

Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Overseer enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

Repeat.

Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.

771-1980-2276-3098-6229.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Call to Mind or Said must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
771-1980-2276-3098-6229.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Call to Mind without paying its mana cost, targeting Said.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Call to Mind, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Call to Minds, causing you to return Said and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Said without paying its mana cost, targeting Call to Mind.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Said, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Saids, causing you to return Call to Mind and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.

You control at least one Clue token.

Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.

Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.

Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Army and Orcish Bowmasters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

The token Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, untapping Feldon.
Activate the token Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

Deal damage to Saber Ants.

Repeat from step 3.

1173-1328-2160.notablePrerequisites: Spellbinder attached to a creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1173-1328-2160.description:
Deal combat damage to a player with the equipped creature.
Spellbinder's second ability triggers, allowing you to cast a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost.
The Final Fortune copy resolves, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and creating a delayed triggered ability that will cause you to lose the game at the end of that turn.
Repeat steps 1 to 3 on your next extra turn.
At the beginning of your end step, a delayed triggered ability from Final Fortune triggers.
In response, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, exiling that ability and ending the turn.
Repeat from step 4 each turn.
